testcase.name: inside the error circle - within the accuracy, in the display unit
outside the circle - rounded to a step no finer than the accuracy, marked approximate
the within boundary - equal is inside, a hair over is outside and rounded to the accuracy's step
no accuracy reported - exactly today's formatting, no marker
a step no coarser than the natural resolution carries no marker
miles - feet below a quarter mile, one decimal of miles from a quarter mile on
kilometres - metres below a kilometre, one decimal of kilometres from a kilometre on
at or above the kilometre and quarter-mile switch the one-decimal formatting is already coarser - unchanged
